title: Metanukimorphosis
content:
The W-Engine Reverberation channel is now available for a limited time only. Use Encrypted Master Tapes to Signal Search.
This W-Engine Reverberation includes: Yesterday Calls, Metanukimorphosis, and Zanshin Herb Case.
Currently selected: Metanukimorphosis. The Signal Search reception rate for the limited S-Rank W-Engine Metanukimorphosis is boosted!
In the Metanukimorphosis channel, Proxies cannot obtain the other two limited S-Rank W-Engine from this period through Signal Search. If you wish to change the rate-up W-Engine, please go to the Signal Search interface and switch to the corresponding tab.
※ The limited S-Rank W-Engine above will not become available in the Star-Studded Cast Stable Channel.
※ Proxies can use the Custom Search function to customize the non-rate-up S-Rank W-Engines.
※ This event Channel is open for a limited time only. All featured Signals may go live again in the future.
※ This channel is a W-Engine Reverberation channel. The Search count for guaranteed Signals is cumulative across all W-Engine Reverberation channels but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Channels.
※ The guarantee system in W-Engine Reverberation channels includes both Special Guarantee and the standard guarantee. Please refer to [W-Engine Reverberation Special Notes] and [W-Engine Reverberation Signal Search] below for the detailed rules.

〓W-Engine Reverberation Special Notes〓
[20% Discount on First 10-Signal Searches]
During each W-Engine Reverberation period, the first 10-Signal Searches will be 20% off, consuming only Encrypted Master Tape ×8. From the 2nd 10-Signal Searches, the number of Encrypted Master Tapes required will return to the original amount.
This offer applies to all channels in the current W-Engine Reverberation and can only be applied once during the current period. Changing the rate-up W-Engine will not reset the discount.
This discount resets with each W-Engine Reverberation update, and unused discounts will not carry over to the next period.
※ Discount only applies to 10-Signal Searches, and single Signal Searches are not discounted.
[Rate-Up W-Engine Guaranteed on First S-Rank Signal]
During the W-Engine Reverberation period, the first S-Rank Signal obtained in this channel is guaranteed to be the currently selected limited S-Rank W-Engine (this guarantee mechanism is hereinafter referred to as "Special Guarantee").
This Special Guarantee applies to all channels in the current W-Engine Reverberation and can only trigger once during the current period. Changing the rate-up W-Engine will not reset the Special Guarantee.
This guarantee resets with each W-Engine Reverberation update, and untriggered guarantee counts will not carry over to the next period.
[Standard Guarantee Carry-Over]
The Special Guarantee for W-Engine Reverberation channels is calculated separately from the standard guarantee, and they do not affect each other.
In the W-Engine Reverberation channels, when obtaining an S-Rank W-Engine for the first time, the Special Guarantee will be triggered first. After the Special Guarantee is triggered, subsequent S-Rank W-Engine signals will follow the standard guarantee rules (see [W-Engine Reverberation Signal Search] below).
※ The standard guarantee counter in the W-Engine Reverberation channels will continue to accumulate. For example: If a Proxy triggers the Special Guarantee in the current W-Engine Reverberation period, continues to Signal Search and obtains a non-limited S-Rank W-Engine, then in the next W-Engine Reverberation period, the first two S-Rank Signals obtained will be the selected limited S-Rank W-Engine.

〓W-Engine Reverberation Signal Search〓
[S-Rank Signals]
In the current W-Engine Reverberation channel, the base probability of an S-Rank W-Engine is 1.000%. Within 80 Signal Searches, at least one S-Rank W-Engine is guaranteed. The overall probability of an S-Rank W-Engine (including the guarantee) is 2.000%. The combined probability (including the guarantee) for the selected limited S-Rank W-Engine is 1.600% (only applies to standard guarantee, and the Special Guarantee is not included in the combined probability for limited S-Rank W-Engines).
After triggering the Special Guarantee, when an S-Rank W-Engine is obtained through this Signal Search, there is a 75.000% probability that the S-Rank Signal obtained is the selected limited S-Rank W-Engine. If the S-Rank W-Engine obtained is not the selected limited S-Rank W-Engine, then the next S-Rank W-Engine obtained is guaranteed to be the selected limited S-Rank W-Engine Metanukimorphosis.
[A-Rank Signals]
In the current W-Engine Reverberation, the base probability of an A-Rank Signal is 15.000%, where the base probability for an A-Rank W-Engine is 11.250% and the base probability for an A-Rank Agent is 3.750%. Within 10 Signal Searches, at least one A-Rank or higher Signal is guaranteed. The overall probability of A-Rank Signals (including the guarantee) is 18.000%.

〓 Special Notes 〓
Residual Signals and Fading Signals can be obtained when Signal Searching in the current Channel. You can exchange Residual Signals and Fading Signals for items in the Signal Shop. See below for details:
[Obtaining an S-Rank Signal]
• Each S-Rank W-Engine obtained in the current Channel will also grant Residual Signal ×40.
[Obtaining an A-Rank Signal]
• The 2nd to 7th copies of an A-Rank Agent will be converted into Agent Focus ×1 and Residual Signal ×8. From the 8th copy onwards, Agents will be converted into Residual Signal ×20.
• Each A-Rank W-Engine obtained in the current Channel will also grant Residual Signal ×8.
[Obtaining a B-Rank Signal]
• Each B-Rank W-Engine obtained in the current Channel will also grant Fading Signal ×20.
